description: This file defines the MembershipService class in PHP, part of the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods for managing membership entities, including creating, retrieving, deleting, and checking for existing memberships, utilizing a Data Access Object (DAO) pattern and normalization traits.

classes.name: MembershipService
classes.description: A service class providing business logic for managing Membership entities, including CRUD operations, existence checks, and normalization.

methods.name: getMembershipDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the MembershipDao instance.

methods.name: saveMembership
methods.description: Saves a Membership entity via DAO.

methods.name: getMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves a Membership by its ID.

methods.name: getMembershipByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Membership by its name.

methods.name: getMembershipList
methods.description: Returns a list of Memberships based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getMembershipCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Memberships matching search parameters.

methods.name: deleteMemberships
methods.description: Deletes multiple Memberships by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingMembershipName
methods.description: Checks if a Membership name already exists.

methods.name: getMembershipArray
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized Membership models.
